entities.summary: Benjamin Bell is an Australian former volleyball player. He was part of the Australia men's national volleyball team as a setter position. On club level, he formerly played for Linköping VC, RWE Volleys Bottrop, Ślepsk Suwałki, Boldklubben Marienlyst and the Queensland Pirates winning several titles. Bell was usually left out in national competition, having played in clubs mostly.
